parole.testo: Borrowed from Turkic, ultimately from Middle Mongol 合班; Compare Kazakh қабан (qaban), Tatar кабан (qaban), Azerbaijani qaban, Turkish kaban (dialectal) and others.

parole.significato: quiver (container for arrows or similar ammunition)
parole.testo: Borrowed via a Turkic language. Ultimately from Middle Mongol ᠰᠠᠭᠠᠳᠠᠭ (saɣadaɣ, “quiver”). Compare Azerbaijani sadaq and Bashkir һаҙаҡ (haðaq).
Inherited from Old Ruthenian черга (čerha), from a Turkic language, compare Azerbaijani cərgə (“row, rank”); ultimately from Middle Mongol ᠵᠡᠷᠭᠡ (ǰerge). Cognates include Belarusian чарга́ (čarhá).
